To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
citrate and H(2O(2) are essential for rapid sphere-to-triangle (STP) shape transformation of silver nanoparticles in a solution containing AgNO3, NaBH4, and PVP.
triangular Ag prisms can be rapidly transformed by shape-selective oxidative dissolution of spheres, rods, cubes, or other bipyramids by H2O2 in the presence of citrate and PVP.
the addition of trisodium citrate and H(2)(2)O(1) to Ag nanoparticles, nanorod, cubes, or nanobipyramids in PVP solutions results in rapid transformation to triangular prisms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
rapid transformation of spherical, cubic, and rodlike silver particles to triangular prisms in aqueous solutions.
the development of a new method for rapid transformation of various shapes of Ag nanoparticles to triangular prisms.
the development of a simple and rapid synthesis of triangular silver prisms from spherical nanoparticles, rods, cubes, bipyramids, or a mixture of these nanostructures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the STP transformation can be induced by the oxidative etching of spherical Ag nanoparticles with citrate and H(2O2) in aqueous solutions, and this transformation is accelerated by the addition of PVP.
rapid sphere-to-prism transformation occurs by the following sequence: Ag nanoparticles (NPs) + NaBH(4)/Na(3)Ca/PVP → Ag NPs + citrate → Ag NPs with citrate → Ag prisms with citrate + Na(3)Ca + PVP.
the rapid STP transformation is initiated by the shape-selective oxidative dissolution of spherical Ag particles by H( 2)O( 2) in the presence of citrate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new shape-selective etching method using H2O2 is useful to synthe size-controlled triangular prisms from various Ag nanoparticles.
the STP transformation can occur in aqueous solutions of AgNO(3), NaBH(4), PVP, and H(3)BO(3).
the shape-selective oxidative dissolution of Ag nanoparticles by the H(2) O(2)/Na(3) CA system is an effective method for the preparation of monodispersed Ag prisms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the rapid STP transformation is a shape-selective oxidative-etching process by H(2O(2)).
the addition of citrate and H(2)(O(2)) is necessary to synthesize triangular prisms from Ag nanostructures.

citrate is an important agent for selective oxidative etching of various Ag nanostructures, including spheres, rods, cubes, and bipyramids, and that it is a key factor in the rapid transformation of these nanostructures into triangular prisms.
